Create detrended meteo input file for the current-climate scenario (CCS).

Source: R/make_CCS.R
make_CCS.Rd

make_CCS use an historical meteo input file to generate a new, detrended meteo input file for the future (called current-climate scenario).

Usage

make_CCS(
  meteo = NULL,
  co2 = NULL,
  obs_year = NULL,
  end_year = 2099,
  outdir = NULL,
  keep_name = TRUE
)

Arguments

meteo

Character or data.frame: Historical meteo data or path to a meteo.txt file. Must have columns "Year", "Month", "n_days", "Rg_f", "Ta_f", "Tmax", "Tmin", "RH_f", "Ts_f", "Precip", "SWC", "LAI", "ET", "WS_f" (see details). Can be created for European sites with the function make_meteo_EOBS, using E-OBS data

co2

Character or data.frame: Historical CO2 data or path to co2.txt file. Must have columns "year" and "CO2_ppm"

obs_year

Numeric vector of length 2: first and last year of historical meteo and CO2 data to be used to generate the future detrended weather. Must be present in both meteo and co2 data.frame

end_year

Numeric: Last year of simulated meteo and co2 data. Default to 2099

outdir

Character: path to the output directory. If does not exist it will be created

keep_name

Logical: if TRUE the name of the detrended file will be the same of the the original one, otherwise the prefix "detrended_" will be add

Value

Used for its side effects. It saves in outdir a meteo.txt and co2.txt file with the same columns of the input data and returns invisibly the table of resampled years.

Details

The input meteo data.frame must have the columns:

  • Year: Reference year for the meteo data

  • Month: number of month in the year

  • n_day: number of day in the month

  • Rg_f: Solar radiation on the ground (in WJ/m-2)

  • Ta_f: Mean temperature (in °C)

  • Tmax: Maximum temperature (in °C)

  • Tmin: Minimum temperature (in °C)

  • RH_f: relative humidity (in %)

  • Ts_f: Daily soil temperature (in °C)

  • Precip: Daily precipitation (in mm day-1)

  • SWC:Soil Water Content (in mm m-2)*

  • LAI:Leaf Area Index (in m2 m-2) *

  • ET: Evapotranspiration (in mm m-2 day-1*

  • WS_f: Wind speed (in m s-1)*

The input co2 data.frame must have the colums:

  • year: Reference year for the co2 data

  • CO2_ppm: CO2 concentration (in ppm)

Only the years up to obs_year[2] of the input data are kept, then the years from obs_year[2] + 1 to end_year are filled by randomly resampling (with a fixed seed, leap years with leap years) the years in obs_year. All the year of simulation must be included in the meteo and co2 input files. For more info on the stand input data needed see the official User's Guide
